subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR keep the runtime legacy no-code missing-source invalidation path, or should legacy cleanup move to doctor/migration-owned repair code?
rationale: The explicit marker follows prior maintainer direction, but the legacy branch intentionally changes upgraded persisted SQLite behavior for no-pluginId diagnostics and needs human acceptance of that compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Require legacy proof, then accept runtime invalidation
options.body: Keep the current code shape if the contributor supplies redacted latest-head output or logs showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

options.title: Accept source and test proof now
options.body: Maintainers can waive the missing external proof and intentionally accept the runtime compatibility behavior based on source inspection and tests.

options.title: Move legacy cleanup out of runtime
options.body: Ask for a narrower PR that keeps explicit new diagnostics in runtime and handles legacy no-code rows through doctor or migration-owned repair.

recommendation.title: Require legacy proof, then accept runtime invalidation
recommendation.body: Keep the current code shape if the contributor supplies redacted latest-head output or logs showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: This person gave the predecessor PR's explicit-marker direction and is the clearest owner for deciding whether the legacy no-code exception fits that boundary.
